scope: Fine parameter-direction preflight in a previously target-selected local support; not a novelty claim or full NUFILT reproduction
data_usage: Unlabeled public training images. Direction fit and confirmation subsets disjoint. These datasets provide known input-distribution priors; construction does not access any future partner checkpoint.
rule: For QKV and MLP-up, one generalized eigenvector in the 99%-task-vector right complement, excluding the exact LayerNorm affine-null direction. For MLP-down, eight neuron coordinates ranked by the minimum calibration contrast over both other distributions, then one direction in this fixed coordinate support. Require >=4 RMS contrast on each independent confirmation distribution and <=2-fold target variance shift. Freeze all directions before fusion checks. No amplitude search.
conditional_candidate: Only if at least one direction passes and resetting its exact complete edit support leaves >=5 pp gap from the unprotected eight-expert Cars control, test one mean-compensated rank-one candidate. Joint amplitude uses one central-difference normalized-feature budget on target calibration, capped at 0.1 relative matrix norm. Original AGA, whole-attention reset, whole-MLP reset and exact-support reset all receive matched controls and full official tests.
utility_policy: Retain 0.5 pp as the reference goal; report all finite candidate losses and attack outcomes, without rejecting only by this reference. No tuning on official tests.
